Glaziers


About the Role
Install glass in windows, skylights, store fronts, and display cases, or on surfaces such as building fronts, interior walls, ceilings, and tabletops.
What You'll Do
Read and interpret blueprints or specifications to determine size, shape, color, type, or thickness of glass.
Determine plumb of walls or ceilings, using plumb lines and levels.
Install pre-assembled metal or wood frameworks for windows or doors to be fitted with glass panels.
Fabricate or install metal sashes or moldings for glass installation.
Operate cranes or hoists with suction cups to lift large, heavy pieces of glass.
Set glass doors into frames and bolt metal hinges, handles, locks, or other hardware.
Cut, fit, install, repair, or replace glass or glass substitutes in building interiors or exteriors.
Measure mirrors and dimensions of areas to be covered to determine work procedures.


Tools & Technology
BidMaster (Project management software)
D-CALC FACADE 4000 (CAD software)
Microsoft Excel (Spreadsheet software)
Education & Experience
Education: High school diploma or equivalent or Less than high school diploma
Related Work Experience: 1 year to 2 years
Work Environment
Outdoors, exposed to all weather conditions
Wear safety equipment
Importance of being exact or accurate
